frame_diff_summary: Mean abs luma diff per frame at 135x240. Only two stretches stay under 0.5 for 6 or more frames: 10.9-11.1s and 13.8-15.0s (round 1 also had 7.0-7.5s, 8.05-10.0s, 12.55-12.75s and 5.2-6.0s). 8.0-10.0s now runs 0.4-1.0 between hops with spikes of 2-3 on 8th-note token hops; 7.0-7.5s holds about 0.5; 5.2-6.0s ramps from 1 to 17 into the drop.
verified_fixes: TASKS PENDING counter: the numeral now starts at about y=255, clear of the top 200px.
'One flow.' header is now at y~290.
8-10s: a data token hops between nodes, each node pops with a purple outline, and the camera drifts and kicks on the beat.
12.4-12.75s: stat panels fade out and the camera pushes to the switch with no cropped label.
End-card letters now reveal on a shared baseline.
Audio: 6.0s drop flux 13.5 (round 1: 7.1), RMS -10.7 to -6.4 dB. Riser and dropout are audible at 5.5-5.9s. 6.5/7.5s snaps flux 13.8/12.4. 13.0s impact flux 9.6.
issues: 7.60-7.67s (frames 228-230): the grid-to-pipeline cross-dissolve still produces doubled UI. Two icon squares sit side by side, labels are duplicated and clipped ('Ne Ne', 'Up Up'), and 'Request approval' appears twice, stacked. On the 7.5s snap beat it reads as a compositing glitch. Fade out the old card's label within 2 frames before the new label fades in, or let each grid card morph into its own pipeline node (one icon, one label) rather than overlaying two layers.

Audio master: per-channel peak is now -0.2 dBFS (volumedetect -0.1 dB), so AAC re-encoding on Instagram is likely to overshoot 0 dBTP and clip. Use a true-peak limiter at -1.0 dBTP. Mean is still dense (-10.4 dB); the ducking is there but there's room for 1-2 dB more contrast in 8-10s.

13.8-15.0s: the end card measures under 0.5 diff per frame, and 14.6-15.0s is exactly 0.0, so the 4% scale finishes early and the last 0.4s is frozen. Keep the scale easing until frame 449, or add a final underline extension or tagline settle on the 14.5s beat.

10.9-11.1s: the app shell sits nearly static (diff 0.0-0.2) while the first stat fades in at low opacity. Snap the first panel in with a scale and y overshoot on the 11.0 beat so the reveal has a hit.

8.0-10.0s: much improved, but between token hops the diff is only 0.4-1.0, so it still reads as gentle. Add a second layer of movement, such as the connector line drawing a purple fill segment behind the token or a 2-3px parallax between header and stack, so the hero sync section feels as energetic as 6-7.5s.
4.75-6.0s: the 'Reminder: send report' card sits at about y 1595-1745, inside the bottom 320px Reels caption zone. Lift the lowest card's resting position to at most y~1560.

13.13-13.27s: mid-reveal, letters clipped at different heights ('VA' with a half-revealed A, then 'VAN') still read as broken type at 30fps for 4 frames. Speed the per-letter stagger (1 frame apart) or use a single-line horizontal mask so the clip edge isn't visible as ragged heights.

12.75-12.97s: the full white frame holds for about 7 frames before the cut to black. Trim to 3-4 frames or let the knob's expansion continue straight into the black end-frame wipe, so it doesn't read as a flash.
